## P&L Forecast

A profit and loss forecast taken part-way through the year. Fields: `asOfMonth` (the last closed month the forecast uses) and `method` (`FORECAST` for a linear trend, `AVERAGE` for a run rate; anything else falls back to `FORECAST`). `fromMonth` and `toMonth` are computed as January and December of that year.

### Queries
- `closes`: `linksToMany(MonthClose)` for the year; each close's account `totals` give the monthly actuals.
- `accounts`: `linksToMany(LedgerAccount)`, to pick out income, cost of goods sold and expense accounts.

### Computed
`rows` (`ForecastRow`) has one row per P&L account with activity up to `asOfMonth`. The remaining months are projected with `@cardstack/bxl`: `FORECAST(month, actuals, months)` (a least-squares line, as Excel's FORECAST.LINEAR) or `AVERAGE(actuals)`. Each row carries `actualMinor` (year to date), `forecastMinor` (rest of year), `fullYearMinor`, `trendMinor` (`SLOPE`, change per month) and, once all twelve months are closed, `outcomeMinor` (what actually happened). Totals: `netActualMinor`, `netForecastMinor` and `netOutcomeMinor`.

The card has no operations.

```ts
import { PnlForecast } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-forecast';
```

### Non-goals
No seasonality, no driver-based or balance-sheet forecasting, and no manual overrides per account.

### Example
`Reports/pnl-forecast-2026-06`, a trend forecast from the first six months of 2026.
attributes.cardDescription: A profit and loss forecast for the rest of the year, projected from the closed months by linear trend or run rate.
